dataset_info.summary: People phoning an e-banking helpline in Australian English, recorded over the telephone across 14 request types. One row is one spoken request with its transcript. The audio is narrowband telephone speech and the delivery is spontaneous rather than read, which is the setting a call-centre deployment faces. The whole registered split is scored, uncapped.
dataset_info.notes: MInDS-14 English (Australia) — telephone-domain speech, 14 intent classes
